title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Ethiopia in 2025, ICSP enhanced health, nutrition and WASH systems in Borena and East Hararghe through closer coordination between health‑facility teams, HEWs, PHEM units and disaster‑preparedness authorities. Joint preparedness for Mpox, Marburg, polio and measles improved surveillance quality and accelerated response times across both zones. Community health structures became more active in promoting maternal nutrition, hygiene and safe‑water practices, reducing vulnerability to recurrent drought and disease outbreaks. Facilities and district teams demonstrated greater readiness and more reliable communication pathways than in earlier ICSP years, enabling high‑risk communities to engage earlier and more confidently with essential services.. GOAL focuses on health system strengthening with the objective of increasing the number and percentage of health facilities providing quality health services (including nutrition services and WASH facilities), so that health and well-being can improve. Social Behaviour Change (SBC) approaches are used to build community and household capacity to care for their own health – including Care Groups, Men’s Health Groups, and community based reproductive health volunteers who work to increase the demand for health services.
